definitions.explanation: A precious white metal used in jewelry, coins, and various applications.

examples.english: The word 'silver world' describes a snow-covered landscape.

notes:
{銀|ぎん} refers to silver as a metal and as a color. It appears in many common compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧: bank (literally 'silver house')
- {銀|ぎん}⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧: silver medal
- {銀|ぎん}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: silver color
- ⟦{銀貨|ぎんか}→銀貨：15787_ginka⟧: silver coin
- ⟦{銀座|ぎんざ}→銀座：30631_ginza⟧: Ginza (famous Tokyo district, historically a silver mint)
- ⟦{水銀|すいぎん}→水銀：17807_suigin⟧: mercury (literally 'water silver')
- {銀|ぎん}⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: silver world (a snow-covered landscape)

METALS SET:
- ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧: gold
- {銀|ぎん}: silver
- ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧: copper/bronze
This set appears together in competitions (⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧, {銀|ぎん}⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧, ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧) and materials.

Note: ⟦{銀髪|ぎんぱつ}→銀髪：14551_ginpatsu⟧ (silver hair) is used in anime/manga for characters with silver-colored hair.
